text: Standing in this modern space, I am struck by a sense of curiosity and subtle anticipation. The glass walls and visible technology evoke a feeling of permeability between interior and exterior, transparency and enclosure. Moving into the vibrant exhibit, 'R+D' boldly displayed, my mind turns to the idea of endless inquiry and progress. I sense the hum of innovation and human ingenuity, and it fills me with the urge to ponder and participate in these evolving conversations. There’s a palpable energy—an invitation to question, to learn, and to contribute.
